one_line: Google released Gemini 4 Neon and Genie 4, Anthropic neared its IPO amid safety and financial scrutiny, and global AI infrastructure investments and security risks grew.

themes.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon and Genie 4
themes.text: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a midtier model designed for software engineering and complex workflows featuring a 1-million-token context window. It also launched Genie 4, an interactive world model capable of generating real-time photorealistic environments with native audio.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google releases Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with native audio

themes.title: Anthropic faces IPO scrutiny and windfall gains
themes.text: Anthropic's upcoming IPO is set to deliver multibillion-dollar returns to early venture backers, while a coalition of scholars challenged the company's safety branding ahead of the public offering.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO set to deliver windfall to smaller VC firms
Coalition challenges Anthropic's safety branding ahead of IPO

themes.title: Tencent AI capex surges as startups secure funding
themes.text: Tencent reported a 527% surge in capital expenditures due to heavy AI infrastructure investments, while startups Soket AI, Humyn Labs, and LanceDB secured fresh funding.

stories.headline: Tencent Q3 profit growth stalls as AI capex surges 5x to ~$12B
Humyn Labs raises $47 million to supply robot training data to U.S. AI developers
LanceDB raises $57.5M Series B to expand multimodal AI lakehouse

themes.title: AI supply chain and agent security breaches
themes.text: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework PyPI package with a credential stealer, and a survey revealed that 92% of Indian organisations experienced AI agent security incidents.

stories.headline: Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package compromised with credential stealer
